correctness.rationale: The five disjoint cell images verify the stated adjacency and slope 2, so each itinerary of n observations has mass 2^(1−n) times its last cell length. Endpoints and all their preimages are null. The rational resolvent and the root formula agree exactly; a separately written rational interval replay agrees for n=1,…,8, including p_8=299/768 and an exact decomposition by first switch or no switch at n=8 (independent_replay.py in /workspace/branches/008fffad-6afa-493c-a019-e6af79698cef/). No reliance on the larger timed-out replay or on execution of the uploaded checker. The two primitive blocks have the same positive simple Perron root γ with strict subleading modulus. The cross term uses the only edge A→B, so bulk indices have mass 2^(1−n)γ^(n−2)c, up to a geometrically decaying relative error in distance from the ends. Perron normalization gives c=11/120+√5/24 and 2c/γ²=(2+√5)/30. Pure-phase and bounded end-window masses are smaller by a factor of order 1/n after conditioning. The Riemann sum gives weak, not exact finite-horizon, uniformity. The leading upstream mass vector is proportional to (γ,1), yielding the stated initial weights.

evidence: Under its aperiodicity and unique ρ-maximal (ρ-final) class hypotheses, equation (5.1) gives (ρ/n)^(τ−1)ρ^(−n)P^n→vu^T, where τ counts the largest number of equal-radius classes traversed by a path and v is positive exactly at starts of such paths.

Both alive blocks here are primitive with common radius ρ=γ/2 and there is access only upstream→downstream. The downstream block is the only ρ-final class, all classes are accessible from the positive initial masses, and τ=2.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The polynomial factor of degree one is included in this general power asymptotic. Upstream and downstream sharing radius does not violate uniqueness of the terminal ρ-maximal class, since the upstream class can reach another class of equal radius. The paper describes endpoint distributions, not the first-switch law verbatim; the explicit implication is in the fourth check.
